scope: Finite existing context21 single and mixed programs, source C demand and previously computed shared-market laws; full-budget symbolic completion, no new route selection
route_count_unit: Unique unordered airport-code endpoint pairs in the synthetic dated model calendar; not accepted operating routes, demand markets, weekly departures or physical aircraft registrations
joint_8_12_gate: 8 <= union of unordered pairs <= 12, plus allocated working labels <=4. Both are necessary model gates only, not sufficient case acceptance
resource: Component working labels summed without a new joint tail optimization; reserve pooled once by explicit assumption; new UFA base counted once
budget_identity: Delta_PnL = C + D_external - F_incremental - B_incremental - S_excluded - L_recognized. C already contains specified variable flight/pax expenses and migrated old-ticket revenue/pax effect. D_external is a named baseline-to-action donor change outside those lines, not the same foregone revenue again.
money_period: RUB per modeled week2026-12-07/13 only; no automatic multiplication to2027/2028
cash: Gross timed receipts/payments, deposits, capex, financing and refunds require separate events; neither contribution nor PnL equals required cash
acceptance: Reconstruct all source leg sets and union counts; unique keys, no MOW expansion; source money values unchanged; model gate not operational clearance
